description: This file defines an internal interface IConnectedClientCollection for managing a collection of connected clients, including a property for versioning and a method to retrieve connected client IDs. It also includes a sealed class EmptyConnectedClientCollection implementing this interface, representing an empty collection with a fixed version.

classes.name: IConnectedClientCollection
classes.description: An internal interface representing a collection of currently connected clients, providing a version number and a method to get connected client IDs.

classes.name: EmptyConnectedClientCollection
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IConnectedClientCollection, representing an empty collection with a fixed version number of 0.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: A property returning the collection's version number, used for change notification.

methods.name: GetConnectedClientIds
methods.description: A method returning a list of GrainId objects representing connected clients.
